core_promise: Call. Qualify. Follow up. Book. Automatically.

headings.instruction: Import Outfit from Google Fonts. Use for all headings. MUST use tracking-tight to tracking-tighter for a premium enterprise feel. H1 max text-5xl to text-6xl. DO NOT use Inter or Space Grotesk.

body.instruction: Import Manrope from Google Fonts. Use for body text for high readability and a clean premium look.

monospace.instruction: Import from Google Fonts. Use for AI call transcripts, lead IDs, data points, and code-like elements.

primary.instruction: Premium Amber/Gold for primary CTA and high-value metrics to reflect the real estate premium vibe (₹1.5-2.5 Cr properties).

accent.instruction: Electric Blue for AI actions, active call states, and processing indicators. DO NOT USE PURPLE OR TEAL GREEN.

visual_enhancers.cards: Cardless or 1px subtle border (#27272A). Flat background (#121212). Sharp edges or max rounded-md (6px). NO heavy drop shadows.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: For sticky headers or floating elements: backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60 with border-b border-white/10.
visual_enhancers.hover_states: Slight lift (-translate-y-0.5), border color shifts to primary or accent, text brightens.
visual_enhancers.ai_call_interface: Tactical Minimalism. Deep Obsidian background. Use 'Electric Blue' for glowing active states (text-shadow or box-shadow). Monospace fonts for timestamps and transcripts.
visual_enhancers.lead_score_visualization: Segmented 10-bar meter or glowing heat-line. Shift from red to green based on score (0-100). Add subtle glow to the active segments.

components.name: KPICard
components.instruction: Flat #121212 background, 1px #27272A border. Value in Outfit text-3xl. Label in uppercase Manrope text-xs tracking-widest text-zinc-400.

components.name: AICallInterface
components.instruction: Centerpiece simulated live call view. Darker inset background (#000000). Use 'tracing beam' effect on borders or pulsing Electric Blue indicator for 'AI Speaking'. Show progressive chat with typing/speaking indicators.

components.name: KanbanBoard
components.instruction: Grid layout. Columns have bg-zinc-950/50. Cards are bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-800. Use drag-and-drop subtle animations. Columns: NEW, CONTACTED, ENGAGED, QUALIFIED, APPOINTMENT, WON, LOST.

components.name: ActivityFeed
components.instruction: Minimal list with a vertical connecting line (border-l border-zinc-800). Use small colored dots (Amber/Blue) for AI vs User actions.

grids_and_layouts.dashboard: High Density Grid (Mode B). grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4. gap-6. Every pixel utilized. Sidebar is persistent.
grids_and_layouts.landing_page: Bento Grid (Mode A). Asymmetric. Generous spacing (py-24, py-32). Deep storytelling layout.

motion.instruction: Subtle, professional micro-interactions. Entrance staggered animations for lists/kanban cards. Smooth AI chat sequence revealing.

accessibility.instruction: Ensure 4.5:1 contrast ratio. Interactive elements must have focus:ring-2 focus:ring-amber-500. Include data-testid on all interactive elements (e.g., data-testid='start-ai-call-btn').

landing_hero.description: Premium modern apartment interior for UrbanNest Realty context

general_ui_ux_guidelines: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (kebab-case).
DO NOT use generic centered layouts. Use left alignment for dense content and optical alignment for icons.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable (e.g., p-8, p-12).
NEVER use generic AI assistant emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡.
DO NOT use complete `transparent` background in header, overlays, or any surface that has content under it.
Use Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react) for a premium duotone or crisp line look.
Avoid generic 'SaaS Blue' or AI 'Purple'. Strictly use the defined Amber/Blue accents against Obsidian.
Do not add global text-align center.
instructions_to_main_agent: You are working with .js / .jsx files. DO NOT output .tsx files.
Create the app in dark mode as default using Tailwind class 'dark'.
For the landing page, build custom layout components using 'raw' HTML/Tailwind for layout freedom.
For the dashboard, customize Shadcn components to match the flat, dark, 1px border aesthetic.
The 'AI Sales Employee ACTIVE' card and 'Start AI Call' interface are the centerpieces. Make them feel highly technical but clean.
Implement the Lead Funnel using a clean, non-standard visual (avoid basic bars, use a flowing staggered list or D3/Recharts if necessary, but keep it high-end).
Ensure all routing works properly for Sidebar (Dashboard, Leads, Pipeline, AI Sales Agent, Appointments, Calls, Settings).
